title: Workshop Dust and Noise Exposure
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=workshop:air location=workshop
| timechart span=5m max(pm25) as dust, max(noise_db) as noise
| eval hearing_risk=if(noise>85,1,0), dust_risk=if(dust>35,1,0)
description: Logs fine dust and noise levels in the workshop, the two exposures that quietly damage lungs and hearing over years.
value: Dust and noise harm accumulates invisibly; a running exposure record prompts a mask or ear defenders before it matters.
implementation: Place air-quality and sound sensors in the workshop; alert when dust or noise crosses safe exposure levels.
visualization: Time chart of workshop dust and noise with safety thresholds.
grandmaExplanation: It measures the dust and noise in your workshop, which can harm your lungs and hearing if you are not careful.
